violation_type.title: Operating in compliance with MS Rules Licensed (26 TAC §746.113(a))
violation_type.short_title: Operating in compliance with MS Rules Licensed
violation_type.typical_finding: The permit holder has not ensured ongoing compliance with the minimum standards based on the operation's 2 year compliance history.  The operation has had multiple standards re-cited during follow up inspections as well as standards cited from the same subchapters.    It was found during the follow up inspection, previous citations had not been brought into compliance. It is the permit holders reponsibility to ensure the compliance of minimum standards.     It was found during the inspection the operation had a high weighted citation during the follow up inspection.
